response.sql: WITH film_actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) as actor_count FROM film f JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) as avg_val FROM film_actor_counts), above_first AS (SELECT fac.film_id, fac.actor_count FROM film_actor_counts fac CROSS JOIN first_avg WHERE fac.actor_count > first_avg.avg_val), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) as avg_val FROM above_first), above_second AS (SELECT af.film_id, af.actor_count FROM above_first af CROSS JOIN second_avg WHERE af.actor_count > second_avg.avg_val) SELECT SUM(actor_count) as sum_actors, AVG(actor_count - (SELECT avg_val FROM first_avg)) as avg_excess_first, AVG(actor_count - (SELECT avg_val FROM second_avg)) as avg_excess_second FROM above_second
